visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish-brown hair, wearing a white graphic sweatshirt, faces the camera holding multiple small plastic bags filled with various foreign banknotes. The background is a plain indoor room with soft lighting and a yellow plush toy visible on the left. (2) She introduces a grey A5-sized ring binder and pulls out one of the transparent zipper pockets, demonstrating its clarity and size. The camera remains at eye-level, focused on her and the binder. (3) The creator begins sorting Japanese Yen bills and coins, sliding them into the first pocket. She uses her fingers to neatly tuck the money inside and then slides the zipper closed. (4) She proceeds to sort a stack of green Korean Won, carefully aligning the edges of the bills and grouping them by denomination before placing them into a new pocket. (5) She realizes she is unsure of a specific currency and brings out an iPad. The screen displays a Google image search for various international banknotes, which she scrolls through with her right hand. (6) She organizes a thick stack of Thai Baht, separating pink and green notes. The editing uses jump cuts to show the progress of sorting and filling the binder pages. (7) In the final phase, she flips through the completed binder, displaying neatly arranged sections of Yen, Won, Euro, and Baht. She smiles at the camera, holding the organized binder close to her chest before the shot cuts out.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, high-pitched female voice speaking rapidly over a steady, upbeat acoustic guitar and light percussion track at roughly 115 BPM. The loud sound of plastic rustling and a sliding zipper trigger the start of this phase. (2) As the speaker describes the binder, frequent 'pop' and 'bubble' sound effects punctuate her sentences. The music maintains a constant volume while she handles bills, creating a rhythmic paper-shuffling sound effect in the mix. (3) A sharp, metallic 'click' sound is heard as the binder rings open, followed by a series of fast 'whoosh' sounds that align with rapid visual cuts. The speaker's tone remains energetic and high-arousal. (4) A digital notification chime sounds when she mentions using the iPad, followed by the faint sound of finger tapping on a screen. The BGM remains in the background, providing a cheerful major-key framework. (5) During the showcase segment, a shimmering 'magic' sound effect is layered over the BGM as the pages are flipped. The rustling of plastic pockets becomes the dominant incidental sound in this phase. (6) The final phase features the speaker concluding with a satisfied exclamation, followed by a final rhythmic guitar flourish and a clean hard cut to silence.
